If we don't Believe in God, How can we be Good?

Young people will carry the responsibility into the new century. It is not only a change from one century to the next, but a change of millenniums which is why it is so important. All nations are making big preparations for this new millennium. They are planning to destroy everything on earth which has been civilised and built for thousands of years.
In this century we had to witness how all the monuments and precious buildings were destroyed by two great wars. I do not think that mankind really want to destroy their homes and their civilisation. There must be something in this world working against humanity which urges people to be enemies and to fight each other, to make wars and to destroy everything materially as well as spiritually here on earth. It is a terrible vision of the future of humanity. If we continue in the same direction in the next millennium, there is no hope for humanity.
You must try to understand how you can protect yourself and your nation against this. We have been created by the Lord of Heavens. Even if Darwin is telling us that we come from monkeys, it is not true. I have never met a monkey which gave birth to a human being, or a mouse giving birth to a cat... Every creature produces its own kind. This is why we believe that human beings all come from one man and one woman. It is what we have been informed of by Prophets and Holy Books and what we believe in. Everything else people try to tell


 us, are theories, imagination. So maybe we imagine this for awhile. Then after some time we will have another idea and imagine something else. We will then decline our first theory and believe in the next. Our minds always produce new ideas.
This is why we believe in all the Holy Books: the New Testament, the Old Testament, Psalms, Thora and the
Holy Quran. They all tell us that man came into existence through Heavenly Creation. We all come from the first couple of man and woman. The root is one, but we have many branches. The Creator created man to be in several kinds. He did not create all men in the same form. They are all different. Everyone represents a special situation. You are unique in your creation. You cannot find two persons to be the same, even if they are twins. Their thinking and points of view will always be different.
We are only guests on this planet for a while. It will not be forever. No one comes here as a permanent guest.
We must go. We must know that this earth belongs to all people and we must know and believe that everyone has rights on this planet. The Lord of Heavens put a rule that you must keep your rights as well as the rights of others. In this century they are telling us about human rights, but they are cheating people. They only mean powerful people. They have rights. Those who are weak and poor don't have any rights. This is a very wrong idea being put into the minds of youngsters. It is why young people try to be much more powerful.
They want to be strong and powerful so that the weak ones will be afraid of them. As long as people do not care and do not respect the rights of others, wars will never stop and there cannot be a bright future for humans.
You are learning so much, but I don't think that you have any lessons to teach you anything about such values. Governments want a secular system where they can keep God outside the school. Why? If we don't believe in God, how can we be good? If you don't believe that there is a power beyond us, you will be a terrible creature, wilder than a wolf. This is why we need to have something in our hearts, in our souls.
This is where we differ from any other creatures on earth, Heavens or oceans. There are so many kinds of creatures, but they are not like you. You belong to mankind, and you are number one. You have been honoured more than any other creature and you carry more responsibility than any other. We know that technology kills everything. It kills your mind. It kills your hearts. It kills your physical being. It destroys and harms. It harms everything connected to nature. The oceans are dying. For what? Because people are



 misusing the power given to them by the Lord of Heavens. We have a mind to think and a will power to decide with.
What are you doing with your will power during the 24 hours of the day? Are you really using your will? Do you think that when you are eating and drinking and dancing that you are using your will? These are natural desires which are directing you. This has nothing to do with will power. Will power is something far beyond that. It means that you are able to stop your physical desires. We were now fasting for one month. I am now fasting a voluntary fast because it gives power and the personality to develop and to shine.
You will have a brilliant personalities. People with such attributes are like stars, like prophets. They are like suns, like moons, like stars, because they prepared their personalities by using their will power. As long as you are trying to control yourself you will reach a good future. Look around in London how many people are finished. They have completely lost control. They have never practised to use their will power, and when devils tempt them they cannot say, 'No!'. Their lives are ending in a very ugly and disliked way. You are young and there are so many devils around chasing you. Don't be their victim. This is London, in a western country with so many traps for young people. Even the governments cannot help you. You yourself must try to use your will power.
I am a sufi master and in front of me everyone is the same. I am not a fanatic person dividing people into being Protestant, Catholic, Anglican, Orthodox, Muslim, Jewish or Buddhist. No! I am interested in mankind.
I am now approaching 80 years and I am travelling far distances. The Lord of Heavens is making me to come and address you now. My heart is full of pity for mankind, because they are being taken the wrong way physically and spiritually. May Allah bless you.
Keep your faith strongly and try to practise your will power and try to be good-ones. You cannot be a goodone as long as you are friends with bad-ones. The most dangerous thing for you is to take bad friends. It harms you and destroys your future. This is the most valuable and precious time in your life. Be careful with it. If not you might suffer your whole life. If you are careful you might still find yourself healthy, wealthy and powerful when you are 80 years old. If not, you will finish quickly.
Reality must appear. This century is full of lies and cheats. It is the century of liars, wolves and foxes. The lions have been taken away, have been shaved, have had their teeth removed and look like monkeys. The


 wolves are spreading everywhere. They never smile, only when they want to eat you. There are countless wolves everywhere. This is why it is so difficult to save youngsters. But we have hope that the Lord of
Heavens will save them.
